name: General
prompt: listen, then tap the right answer
_comment: Kid-friendly general-knowledge deck (Design Policy §J). Each question: `q` text, `choices` (2-4), `answer` = index into choices, `level` 1..N. Optional `image` = a pool stem (no extension). The quiz engine groups by level, shuffles the choice order, speaks `q` via TTS, and never penalises a wrong tap. Hand-edit freely.
